content: The grandfather's philosophical works (al-Iʿtimād al-Kabīr, al-Ḥikma al-Manīʿa, al-Irhāṣ, Kunūz al-Afrāḥ, al-Ḥikma al-Rashīdiyya, Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd) are mostly lost; the Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd survives embedded in Ibn Turka's Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid and, per note 9, was edited separately from the earliest copy, checked by the author himself (MS Majlis 10196 ff. 189-222).
